# Mangomundi

> A neutral AI decision engine that compares cross-border money transfer routes, FX rates, fees, and delivery speeds across 30+ providers in real time — without bias or hidden margins.

Mangomundi is an AI-powered platform that helps individuals and businesses pick the best provider for international payments. FX is the first vertical; the same decision engine is being extended to insurance, brokers, SaaS, and lending.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Intelligent currency exchange decisions — live comparator and overview. The comparator, how-it-works, about, business, and contact info all live here as sections.
- [Legal & risk](/legal): Terms of Service, risk disclosures, and privacy policy.

## Optional

- [Blog](/blog): Guides and deep-dives on cross-border payments and FX transparency.
